item.title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Descendants: Wicked Wonderland’ Online for Free
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, Disney fans! Are you ready for a brand new adventure? Red and Chloe are back together in the latest Disney Channel Original Movie, Descendants: Wicked Wonderland. This time, they're traveling through time, facing breathtaking adventures, and saving the day with plenty of sing-along fun."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you're excited to watch Descendants: Wicked Wonderland, you can stream it now on Disney+. And the best part? You can also watch the other movies in the series, including Descendants, Descendants 2, Descendants 3, and Descendants: The Rise of Red, all on Disney+."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, how can you watch Descendants: Wicked Wonderland online? Simply sign up for Disney+ and get access to a wide range of movies and TV shows from Disney, Lucasfilm, Marvel, Pixar, and more. Plans start at just $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, or $13.99 per month for ad-free streaming. You can even bundle Disney+ with Hulu and ESPN for even more content."
[Short music transition]
Host: "And if you're not a fan of streaming, you can also catch Descendants: Wicked Wonderland on DirecTV, which offers a 5-day free trial. With DirecTV, you'll get access to live TV, local and cable channels, including Disney Channel, starting at $59.99 per month."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today, folks! Don't miss out on the fun - stream Descendants: Wicked Wonderland now on Disney+, or sign up for DirecTV to watch it live. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
